scripts.prebuild: cd ../lambda && go mod download && make build
scripts.diff: bun prebuild && bun precheck && ./scripts/load-env.sh cdk diff
scripts.deploy: bun prebuild && bun precheck && ./scripts/load-env.sh cdk deploy
scripts.local:bootstrap: EDGE_PORT=4566 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 cdklocal bootstrap
scripts.local:deploy: bun prebuild && EDGE_PORT=4566 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 cdklocal deploy --require-approval never && bun run local:postdeploy
scripts.local:postdeploy: EDGE_PORT=4566 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:4566 bun run scripts/seed-db.ts
scripts.local:seed: EDGE_PORT=4566 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:4566 bun run scripts/seed-db.ts
scripts.local:destroy: EDGE_PORT=4566 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 cdklocal destroy
